scope: Provenance archives consolidated under .provenance by explicit owner request, 2026-11-13. No source/obligation authority change.

summary.disposition: All 1019 retained payloads relocated byte-for-byte under .provenance without deleting/reclassifying sources. previous_path preserves the pre-consolidation location; original_path preserves source identity. No archived duplicates created.

classification_reasons.registered-source: Canonical local provenance; existing mandated paths and hashes retained, including ZIP containers and execution records.
classification_reasons.historical-review: Historical baseline with live navigation and unresolved finding provenance; not wholesale superseded by LikeC4.
classification_reasons.private-immutable-master: Unredacted immutable master; duplicate public bytes do not permit breaking exact closed snapshot.
classification_reasons.public-historical-snapshot: Owner-authorized permanent public historical derivative and original controls; retained as an exact snapshot.
classification_reasons.publication-review: Publication/redaction/rights provenance; historical does not mean dispensable.

policy.entry_contents: Paths, byte counts, SHA256, classifications and recovery references only; no source payload contents.
policy.archive_eligibility: Only definitively superseded historical-review duplicates with explicit supersession reference, exact independent recovery copy and intact original-path compatibility route.
policy.protected: Registered sources, active/proposed/unresolved obligations, immutable masters/snapshots, protocol/proof evidence, license texts and staged owner work.
policy.limits: Hash equality is not semantic supersession; historical evidence remains historical, not active instruction. Private recovery bytes are not available from this tracked manifest.
policy.index: Relocation changes filesystem paths only; no index-writing command. Public historical archives remain unignored; private roots remain ignored.

existing_optional_documentation.disposition: Observed before this archival change and confirmed afterward; no source byte, registered path, ZIP member or archive hash failures. Existing migrated-body expectations are outside this task's ownership and are not rewritten here.

validation.index: No index-writing commands executed. Existing staged .gitignore changes remain; .archive has no indexed paths and is ignored.
validation.scope_limit: No application, browser, build, runtime, Lean replay or publication checks were required or performed; existing evidence and immutable bytes were not modified.
